messages.content: 這家企業的營收為15000美元，總成本為22000美元，回報率是多少？

function.name: investment_analysis_calculate_profit
function.description: Calculates the net profit given the total revenue and total cost Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

total_revenue.description: The total revenue for the business. This is a float type value.

total_cost.description: The total cost for the business. This is a float type value.

tax_rate.description: The tax rate for the business, default is 0.2. This is a float type value.

message.content:
根據公式：

\[
\text{投資回報率（ROI）}= \frac{\text{營收}-\text{總成本}}{\text{總成本}}\times 100\%
\]

將數值代入：

\[
\text{ROI}= \frac{15\,000-22\,000}{22\,000}\times 100\%
          = \frac{-7\,000}{22\,000}\times 100\%
          \approx -31.8\%
\]

也就是說，該企業在此期間虧損約 \$7,000，投資回報率約為 **-31.8%**。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "這家企業的營收為15000美元，總成本為22000美元，回報率是多少？" They want the return on investment (ROI). ROI formula: (Revenue - Cost) / Cost * 100%. So (15000-22000)/22000*100% = (-7000/22000)*100% ≈ -31.818%. So negative ROI ~ -31.8%. We can use the tool to calculate net profit but not ROI. But we can compute manually. The tool calculates net profit given revenue, cost, tax_rate. But they didn't ask for net profit; they asked for ROI. We can compute ROI ourselves. Provide answer: ROI = -31.8%. Also mention net loss of $7,000. Use the tool? The tool calculates net profit: net_profit = (total_revenue - total_cost)*(1-tax_rate). But we don't need tax. We can just compute net profit: 15000-22000 = -7000. Then ROI = -7000/22000*100% = -31.8%. Provide answer.
